name: Everything Changes!
source: The story of Ethan, a simple and a bit naive boy who goes from adolescence to adulthood, discovering how to face some dilemmas of life, his sexuality and his powers. powers? yes! This Visual Novel is a fantasy sexual comedy, created to make you smile, spend nice moments relaxing and addressing some issues such as homosexuality and many internal conflicts related to ethics!
translation: 故事讲述了单纯又有些天真的男孩伊森从青春期走向成年的历程。他逐渐学会面对人生中的种种难题，认识自己的性取向，还有自己的超能力。超能力？没错！这是一部奇幻性喜剧视觉小说，希望让你会心一笑，度过轻松愉快的时光，同时探讨同性恋，以及与伦理相关的种种内心冲突。
